title: In the kitchen
about: Words for things in the kitchen: the fridge, the cooker, a saucepan, plates, cups and spoons. Also useful questions for helping in someone's kitchen, like Where can I find …? and Can I help with …?

parts.title: Things we use in the kitchen
Things we use for eating and drinking
Tip
parts.note: Порада: наклей на речі у своїй кухні папірці з англійськими назвами — fridge, cupboard, mug, tap. Ти бачитимеш їх щодня, і слова запам'ятаються самі. І стережися «фальшивих друзів»: деякі англійські слова схожі на українські, але означають зовсім інше.

items.pattern: in the fridge · put sth in the fridge
items.meaning: a cold box that keeps food fresh
items.example: Can you put the butter back in the **fridge**?
more: There's some orange juice in the **fridge**. Help yourself.
Our **fridge** is full of food for the party.
items.watchOut: Повне слово — refrigerator, але в житті майже завжди кажуть fridge. Вимова /frɪdʒ/, з «дж» у кінці.

items.pattern: in the freezer
items.meaning: a very cold box that keeps food frozen
items.example: There's some ice cream in the **freezer**.
more: Mum keeps bread in the **freezer**, so it stays fresh for weeks.
Get some ice from the **freezer** for our drinks.

items.pattern: in the cupboard · a kitchen cupboard
items.meaning: a piece of furniture with doors, where you keep cups, plates or food
items.example: The cups are in the **cupboard** above the sink.
more: We keep rice and pasta in this **cupboard**.
Close the **cupboard** door, please. I always hit my head on it.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈkʌbəd/: p не вимовляється, звучить приблизно як «каб-ед». Шафа для одягу — wardrobe.

items.pattern: on the shelf · the top / bottom shelf · shelves
items.meaning: a long flat board on a wall or in a cupboard, for putting things on
items.example: The jam is on the top **shelf**.
more: I can't reach the **shelf**. Can you help me?
There are three **shelves** in our fridge.
items.watchOut: Множина — shelves, з v. На полиці — on the shelf (on, бо річ лежить зверху).

items.pattern: in the microwave · heat sth in the microwave
items.meaning: a small oven that heats food very quickly
items.example: Heat the soup in the **microwave** for two minutes.
more: The popcorn is ready! Take it out of the **microwave**.
Our **microwave** is next to the fridge.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈmaɪkrəweɪv/ — «майкровейв», а не «мікро».

items.pattern: turn on / turn off the tap · the hot / cold tap
items.meaning: you turn it to get water
items.example: Don't forget to turn off the **tap**!
more: The water from this **tap** is very cold.
Wash your hands under the **tap**.
items.watchOut: Водопровідний кран — tap. Crane — це підйомний кран на будівництві (і птах журавель). В Америці кажуть faucet.

items.pattern: in the sink · wash sth in the sink
items.meaning: the place in the kitchen where you wash plates and cups
items.example: Leave your dirty plate in the **sink**.
more: The **sink** is full of dirty cups after the party.
Fill the **sink** with hot water and wash the saucepans.
items.watchOut: Раковину у ванній часто називають washbasin, але sink теж кажуть. Дієслово sink означає інше — «тонути».

items.pattern: on the worktop
items.meaning: the flat top of the kitchen cupboards, where you prepare food
items.example: I left my keys on the **worktop**.
more: Clean the **worktop** after you cut the bread.
The toaster is on the **worktop** next to the sink.
items.watchOut: Не table: table — стіл, за яким їдять. Американці кажуть counter.

items.pattern: in the bin · put / throw sth in the bin
items.meaning: a container for rubbish
items.example: Put the banana skin in the **bin**, please.
more: There's a **bin** under the sink.
I threw the old newspaper in the **bin**.
items.watchOut: Сміття — rubbish (брит.) або trash (амер.). Американці кажуть trash can.

items.pattern: put clothes in the washing machine
items.meaning: a machine that washes clothes
items.example: My football shirt is in the **washing machine**.
more: Can you take the clothes out of the **washing machine**?
Our **washing machine** is very noisy.
items.watchOut: Саме washing machine, не wash machine. У Британії вона часто стоїть на кухні. Посуд миє інша машина — dishwasher.

items.pattern: on the cooker · a gas / an electric cooker
items.meaning: a big kitchen machine with an oven, where you cook food
items.example: The soup is on the **cooker**. It's still hot.
more: Our **cooker** has four rings and an oven.
We've got a new electric **cooker**.
items.watchOut: Cooker — плита, а cook — кухар (і дієслово «готувати»). Plate — це тарілка, а не плита! В Америці плита — stove.

items.pattern: put sth in the dishwasher · empty the dishwasher
items.meaning: a machine that washes plates, cups, knives and forks
items.example: Put your bowl in the **dishwasher** after breakfast.
more: Can you empty the **dishwasher**? The plates are clean.
We haven't got a **dishwasher**, so we wash everything by hand.

items.pattern: some washing-up liquid · a bottle of washing-up liquid
items.meaning: soap for washing plates and cups by hand
items.example: There's no **washing-up liquid**. Can you buy some?
more: Put a little **washing-up liquid** in the hot water.
This **washing-up liquid** smells of lemons.
items.watchOut: Зазвичай не рахується: some washing-up liquid, a bottle of washing-up liquid. Washing liquid — це засіб для прання. Американці кажуть dish soap.

items.pattern: dry sth with a tea towel
items.meaning: a cloth for drying plates, cups and glasses
items.example: Can you dry the glasses with this **tea towel**?
more: The **tea towels** are in the drawer next to the cooker.
My grandma gave me a **tea towel** with a map of London on it.
items.watchOut: Tea towel не має нічого спільного з чаєм: ним витирають посуд. Американці кажуть dish towel.

items.pattern: in a saucepan · boil sth in a saucepan
items.meaning: a deep round metal pot with a handle and a lid, for cooking
items.example: Boil the pasta in a big **saucepan**.
more: Dad is making hot chocolate in a small **saucepan**.
Be careful! The **saucepan** is very hot.
items.watchOut: Вимова /ˈsɔːspən/ — «сос-пен». Часто кажуть просто pan.

items.pattern: in a frying pan · fry sth in a frying pan
items.meaning: a flat pan for frying food
items.example: Mum is making pancakes in the **frying pan**.
more: Heat some oil in the **frying pan** before you add the onions.
This **frying pan** is too small for six eggs.
items.watchOut: Саме frying pan (від fry — смажити), а не fry pan. Часто кажуть і просто pan.

items.pattern: make tea in a teapot
items.meaning: a pot for making and pouring tea
items.example: Grandma always makes tea in a **teapot**.
more: Be careful, the **teapot** is full of hot tea.
We bought a pretty blue **teapot** on holiday.
items.watchOut: Чайник, у якому кип'ятять воду, — kettle. Teapot — заварник: у ньому заварюють чай.

items.pattern: make coffee in a coffee maker · turn on the coffee maker
items.meaning: a machine or pot for making coffee
items.example: Dad turns on the **coffee maker** every morning.
more: Our **coffee maker** makes four cups at a time.
Is there any coffee in the **coffee maker**?

items.pattern: a cloth · a wet / clean cloth · wipe sth with a cloth
items.meaning: a small piece of material for cleaning or wiping
items.example: Can you clean the table with a wet **cloth**?
more: There's a **cloth** next to the sink.
I wiped the milk off the floor with a **cloth**.
items.watchOut: Не плутай: cloth /klɒθ/ — ганчірка, clothes /kləʊðz/ — одяг.

items.pattern: some kitchen roll · a piece of kitchen roll
items.meaning: soft paper on a roll, for cleaning or drying in the kitchen
items.example: Oh no, juice on the floor! Have we got any **kitchen roll**?
more: Dry the fish with a piece of **kitchen roll**.
We need to buy some **kitchen roll** at the supermarket.
items.watchOut: Зазвичай не рахується: some kitchen roll, a piece of kitchen roll. Американці кажуть paper towels.

items.pattern: a cup of tea / coffee
items.meaning: a small round thing with a handle, for hot drinks
items.example: Would you like a **cup** of tea?
more: My little sister drinks milk from a red **cup**.
There are six **cups** on the shelf.
items.watchOut: Чашка чаю — a cup of tea, з of. Не a cup tea.

items.pattern: a bowl of soup / cereal / salad
items.meaning: a deep round dish for soup, cereal or salad
items.example: There's a **bowl** of fruit on the table.
more: Put the salad in a big **bowl**.
Our cat has a blue **bowl** for her food.
items.watchOut: Вимова /bəʊl/ — «боул», як у слові bowling. «Тарілка супу» англійською — a bowl of soup, бо суп їдять із глибокої тарілки.

items.pattern: a plate · on a plate · a plate of sth
items.meaning: a flat round dish for food
items.example: Put the sandwiches on a **plate**, please.
more: My **plate** is empty. Can I have some more?
Be careful with those **plates**. They're Grandma's.
items.watchOut: Plate — тарілка, а не плита! Плита — cooker. На тарілці — on a plate.

items.pattern: a fork · eat with a knife and fork
items.meaning: you use it to pick up food; it has three or four points
items.example: Can I have a **fork**? I want to eat my salad.
more: Hold your **fork** in your left hand.
Small children often eat with a spoon, not a **fork**.
items.watchOut: Кажуть a knife and fork — без другого a і саме в такому порядку.

items.pattern: a knife · knives · cut sth with a knife
items.meaning: you use it to cut food
items.example: Cut the cake with this **knife**.
more: Be careful! That **knife** is very sharp.
The **knives** and forks are in the drawer.
items.watchOut: k на початку не вимовляється: /naɪf/. Множина — knives, з v.

items.pattern: eat with chopsticks · a pair of chopsticks
items.meaning: two thin sticks for eating, used in China, Japan and other countries
items.example: Can you eat noodles with **chopsticks**?
more: At the Japanese restaurant, we all used **chopsticks**.
My brother is learning to eat rice with **chopsticks**.
items.watchOut: Зазвичай у множині: chopsticks, a pair of chopsticks. Їсти паличками — eat with chopsticks, з with.

items.pattern: a spoon · a teaspoon · eat sth with a spoon
items.meaning: you use it to eat soup or to put sugar in your tea
items.example: You need a **spoon** for this soup.
more: Can I have a **spoon** for my ice cream?
The baby is learning to eat with a **spoon**.
items.watchOut: Чайна ложка — teaspoon. «Ложка цукру» частіше кажуть a spoonful of sugar або a teaspoon of sugar.

items.pattern: a mug of tea / hot chocolate
items.meaning: a big cup with straight sides and a handle
items.example: I drink my hot chocolate from a big **mug**.
more: My mum has a **mug** with a picture of a dog on it.
I made a **mug** of tea and sat on the sofa.
items.watchOut: Mug — велика кружка з прямими стінками, зазвичай без блюдця. Cup — менша чашка, часто з блюдцем.

items.pattern: a glass of water / juice / milk · glasses
items.meaning: a thing made of glass for cold drinks
items.example: Can I have a **glass** of water, please?
more: Be careful, that **glass** is full.
There are clean **glasses** in the cupboard.
items.watchOut: A glass — склянка (рахується, множина glasses). Glass без a — скло: The table is made of glass.

items.pattern: Where can I find a / some / the + noun?
items.meaning: a polite question when you are looking for something
items.example: **Where can I find** a spoon?
more: Excuse me, **where can I find** the milk in this shop?
**Where can I find** some kitchen roll? I dropped my juice.
items.watchOut: У питанні can стоїть перед I: Where can I find …? Не Where I can find …?

items.pattern: Can I help with the cooking / the washing-up? · Can I help you with sth?
items.meaning: a friendly question when you want to help someone
items.uk: Можна допомогти з …? Тобі допомогти з …?
items.example: **Can I help with** the cooking, Mum?
more: **Can I help with** the shopping bags?
**Can I help** you **with** your homework?
items.watchOut: Допомогти з роботою — help with: help with the cooking. А з місцем — help in: help in the kitchen.

items.pattern: do the washing-up · help with the washing-up
items.meaning: washing the plates, cups, knives and forks after a meal
items.example: I'll cook dinner, and you can **do the washing-up**.
more: After the party, we did the **washing-up** together.
There's a lot of **washing-up** in the sink.
items.watchOut: Мити посуд — do the washing-up (брит.) або wash the dishes / do the dishes. Не make the washing-up. А do the washing — це прання.

items.pattern: dry the plates / the glasses · dry sth with a tea towel
items.meaning: make something dry with a cloth or a towel
items.example: You wash the cups, and I'll **dry** them.
more: She **dried** her hands on a towel.
Can you **dry** the knives and put them away?
items.watchOut: Мокрий посуд витирають — dry. Стіл ганчіркою — wipe the table. Минулий час — dried (y → i).

items.pattern: Where does this / this cup go? · Where do these go?
items.meaning: a question when you want to know where to put something away
items.uk: Куди це покласти / поставити? Де це стоїть?
items.example: **Where does** this bowl **go**?
more: **Where do** these glasses **go**? In this cupboard?
Thanks for your help! **Where does** the bread **go**?
items.watchOut: «Куди це поставити?» англійською звучить природно як Where does this go? Потрібне does: не Where this goes? Для множини — Where do these go?

warmup.explain: Плита — cooker. Plate — тарілка, а cook — кухар.
Склянка води — a glass of water, обов'язково з of.
Водопровідний кран — tap. Crane — підйомний кран, sink — раковина.
У питанні can стоїть перед I: Where can I find …?
Миття посуду — the washing-up. The washing — це прання, а dishwasher — посудомийна машина.
Where does this go? — з does, бо this bowl — одна річ. Для множини — Where do these go?
Заварник — teapot. Kettle — чайник, у якому кип'ятять воду, saucepan — каструля.

warmup.uk: Мені потрібна ганчірка, щоб витерти стіл.
warmup.q: I need a ___ to clean the table.
warmup.explain: Ганчірка — cloth. Clothes — одяг, plate — тарілка.

A.q: It's hot today. Let's keep the juice in the ___.
A.explain: Щоб сік був холодний, його тримають у холодильнику — fridge.

A.q: Fill the kettle with water from the ___.
This banana is old and brown. Throw it in the ___.

B.q: Put some ___ in the water before you wash the plates.
B.explain: У воду для посуду додають засіб для миття — washing-up liquid.

B.q: I use a ___ to dry the cups.
B.explain: Посуд витирають рушником — tea towel. Teapot — заварник, saucepan — каструля.

C.q: We had noodles at the Chinese restaurant and ate them with ___.
C.explain: У китайському ресторані їдять паличками — chopsticks.

C.q: Tom eats his cereal from a big ___ every morning.
C.explain: Суп їдять із глибокої тарілки — a bowl of soup.

D.q: Excuse me, where can I ___ the cups?
D.explain: Where can I find …? — де можна знайти. Шукати щось — look for, search for, а не look / search без for.

D.q: After dinner, I did the ___ and Dad dried the plates.
D.explain: Тато витирав тарілки, отже я їх мив — did the washing-up.

D.q: 'This plate is clean. Where does it ___?' 'In the cupboard on the left.'
D.explain: Where does it go? — куди його поставити. Після does дієслово без -s.

example.title: Pancakes for Grandma
example.uk:
У неділю вранці я спекла млинці для бабусі. Я дістала яйця й молоко з холодильника. Я знайшла велику миску в шафці. Я все перемішала ложкою.

Потім я налила трохи олії на сковороду на плиті. Мій перший млинець був жахливий, але другий вийшов чудовий!

Бабуся заварила чай у своєму старому заварнику. Після сніданку бабуся спитала: «Можна допомогти тобі з миттям посуду?» «Так, будь ласка!» — сказала я. «Я помию, а ти можеш витерти тарілки».
example.en:
On Sunday morning, I made pancakes for Grandma. I took the eggs and milk out of the [[fridge|a1]]. I found a big [[bowl|c2]] in the [[cupboard|a3]]. I mixed everything with a [[spoon|c7]].

Then I put some oil in the [[frying pan|b4]] on the [[cooker|a11]]. My first pancake was terrible, but the second one was great!

Grandma made tea in her old [[teapot|b5]]. After breakfast, Grandma asked, "[[Can I help with|d2]] the [[washing-up|d3]]?" "Yes, please!" I said. "I'll wash, and you can [[dry|d4]] the [[plates|c3]]."
